instruction: Help me enable the always-on-top feature in VLC so the video window stays above other windows

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to enable VLC video-on-top by setting 'video-on-top=1' in vlcrc. The evaluator reads the configuration file and verifies the setting is enabled (value 1). Default value is 0 (disabled). This makes the video window stay above all other windows.
